Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.openlineage

Interface OpenLineageListenerManager

All Known Implementing Classes:
IntegrationContextManager, OIFContextManager
public interface OpenLineageListenerManager
OpenLineageListenerManager is the interface used by integration connectors to register for, and publish, OpenLineage events within an integration daemon.

  • Method Details

    • registerListener

      void registerListener(OpenLineageEventListener listener)
      The listener is implemented by the integration connector to receive OpenLineage events. Only one listener can be registered by a connector.
      Parameters:
      listener - listener to register

    • publishOpenLineageRunEvent

      void publishOpenLineageRunEvent(String rawEvent)
      Called each time an OpenLineage event is published to the integration daemon as a JSON string. The event is parsed into the appropriate bean (run event, job event or dataset event, determined by the properties present) and delivered to each of the registered listeners. If the event cannot be parsed it is delivered to the run event listeners with a null bean and the raw event only.
      Parameters:
      rawEvent - event in Json form from the originator - may have facets that are not known to Egeria

    • publishOpenLineageRunEvent

      void publishOpenLineageRunEvent(OpenLineageRunEvent event)
      Called each time an OpenLineage run event is published to the integration daemon as a bean. The event is serialized into JSON and delivered, along with the bean, to each of the registered listeners.
      Parameters:
      event - bean representation of the event

    • publishOpenLineageJobEvent

      void publishOpenLineageJobEvent(OpenLineageJobEvent event)
      Called each time an OpenLineage job event is published to the integration daemon as a bean. The event is serialized into JSON and delivered, along with the bean, to each of the registered listeners.
      Parameters:
      event - bean representation of the event
